intent: Four new Selantis continuation cutscenes adapted from combined novel and film evidence. These are game illustrations, not existing filmed frames.

canon.lia: Novel appearance: long strawberry-blonde curls loosely half gathered, white gathered round-neck peasant blouse, long brown skirt, leather travel shoes.
canon.kyra: Novel appearance: long nut-brown hair, brown eyes, dirt-stained beige ankle-length dress, thin leather shoes.
canon.flick: Film-derived short auburn hair, pointed ears, cream tunic, burgundy cape, wooden bow and quiver.
constraints: Baris and Orwen are distinct from Vardis.
Lia's magic is a single involuntary burst, with immediate exhaustion.
No staff, hidden magic item, blood, or gore.
The hooded Meister remains unnamed; Vardis's death is not established.

evidence: docs/episode-01.md: Flick appearance at 11:37, awakening 17:50-18:22, master's rebuke 18:50-19:30.

Scene: rain-dark forest at night after Lia has fled a dangerous Brotherhood camp. Create an emotional first meeting.
